recognize_zh: 低倍下左上角可見小腸絨毛黏膜，其下方腸壁被一大片均一、瀰漫性的淋巴樣細胞取代並伴有出血；這是腸道（非淋巴結）的瀰漫性淋巴瘤浸潤，典型的 starry-sky 淡色巨噬細胞斑點在此倍率下僅隱約可見，需高倍確認。
features: Small intestinal mucosa with villi and crypts at the upper left edge
Underlying bowel wall replaced by a diffuse, sheet-like, monotonous lymphoid infiltrate
Loss of normal submucosal and mural architecture without nodularity
Foci of hemorrhage at the mucosa-tumor interface
Starry-sky mottling from tingible-body macrophages is only faintly discernible at this low magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows small intestinal mucosa with villi at the upper left, beneath which the bowel wall is effaced by a diffuse, monotonous, sheet-like lymphoid infiltrate with scattered foci of hemorrhage. No nodular or follicular architecture is present. At this magnification the characteristic starry-sky pattern of interspersed tingible-body macrophages is only faintly appreciable, and cytologic features cannot be assessed; the tissue is intestine rather than lymph node as the title states. In the ileocecal region of a young patient, this diffuse transmural lymphoid infiltrate is suggestive of Burkitt lymphoma, pending high-power cytology, Ki-67, CD10/BCL2 and MYC studies.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is composed of larger pleomorphic cells with vesicular nuclei, variable BCL2 expression and Ki-67 usually below near-100%.
Mantle cell lymphoma forms multiple nodules of small cyclin D1-positive cells without a starry-sky pattern.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma can show starry-sky change but is TdT-positive with fine blastic chromatin.
Myeloid sarcoma contains eosinophilic myelocytes and is MPO/CD117-positive rather than CD20/CD10-positive.
